coordinate_system.facade_anchor: Bottom centre of the 3m x 3.5m bay; front wall plane z=0.

description: Original physical modular prison/service-building kit; not a rendered quality claim.

geometry_policy.placement: Root owns placements and scan-surface masking. Do not cover gates, required entrances or collision routes.
geometry_policy.uvs: Planar material coordinates in metres, cylindrical arc/height in metres; brick profile repeats every2m.
geometry_policy.window_detail: Real opening, chamfered reveal, recessed opaque dark glass, molded metal frame, 6 panes, sloped sill.

material_provenance.license: Existing Poly Haven CC0 maps, unchanged and referenced in place.

modules.name: FacadeWindow
modules.notes: Glass is recessed 0.195m; no emission. Wall has a physical opening.

modules.name: FacadeBarredWindow
modules.notes: Six cylindrical steel bars, three cross rails and bolted mounts.

modules.name: FacadeBoardedWindow
modules.use: Boarded closed window for abandoned service buildings

modules.name: FacadeBlank
modules.use: Continuous solid wall bay; do not cover a playable doorway

modules.name: AccessDoor
modules.notes: Noninteractive visual module. Never place across a required gameplay entrance.

modules.name: RoofCornice
modules.notes: Anchor at bottom of coping, not bottom of storey. Front projects 0.25m.
modules.use: Continuous roof-edge coping/cornice; snap adjacent segments at 3m

modules.name: Drainpipe
modules.notes: Pipe is 108mm diameter with flared upper socket and three metal mounts.
modules.use: Narrow vertical facade accent; place away from window and door openings

modules.name: RoofDeck
modules.notes: Anchor is roof centre at finished membrane Y0. Roof slab bottomY-.20, membraneY0, coping topY+.13. Place only with matching separately authored support collision.
modules.use: Closed flat roof visuals with physical coping and metal flashing

modules.name: RoofCoping
modules.notes: Start anchor X0, length along +X, bottomY0; width approximately .19m. Construct variable lengths with coping_parts(length) rather than stretching UVs.
modules.use: Metre-length edge trim with folded metal flashing

modules.name: RoofChimney
modules.notes: Bottom-centre anchor; no world placement. Native surviving chimney details are retained by the tower rebuild.
modules.use: Optional masonry flue for authored prison roofs

roof_api.anchor: Roof centre at finished membraneY0; +X facade right, +Z facade interior, +Y up.
roof_api.returns: List of (part_name, geometry.Mesh, material_name); no files written or colliders created.
roof_api.support: Runtime owner must create separately verified support with top exactly at the membrane plane.
